title: PNP: No proof yet drugs seized in Laos, Thailand bound for Philippines

blocks.text: The Philippine National Police (PNP) said Friday it was verifying claims that illegal drugs seized in Laos and Thailand were bound for the Philippines, saying there was no evidence yet confirming Manila was the intended destination.
